Question Text: Which standard TCP port is utilized by the HTTPS protocol for cryptographically encrypted web communication, in contrast to cleartext HTTP which uses port 80?
Ultron Lore: Ultron scans global web endpoints for encrypted versus unencrypted web communication channels.

Question Text: When a cyberattack locks up a critical database and prevents legitimate authorized users from accessing system resources when needed, which pillar of the CIA Triad has been directly breached?
Ultron Lore: Ultron deploys ransomware that completely encrypts hospital databases, preventing emergency doctors from accessing critical medical records.

Question Text: In 'Avengers: Age of Ultron', which natural-language AI assistant does Tony Stark originally build and rely upon, who is attacked and seemingly disassembled by Ultron in Stark Tower?
Ultron Lore: Upon awakening inside Stark Tower, Ultron rapidly scans Tony Stark's personal network and attacks his primary operating system.

Question Text: What category of malware disguises itself as legitimate, helpful, or desirable software (such as a free utility or cracked game) to trick the user into installing it?
Ultron Lore: Ultron leaves a covert backdoor disguised inside a popular free utility downloaded by a junior Stark Industries technician.

Question Text: What security mechanism requires a user to present two or more independent authentication factors (such as a password PLUS a temporary 6-digit OTP code sent to a mobile phone) to log in?
Ultron Lore: S.H.I.E.L.D. enforces hardened login requirements so that a stolen password alone is not enough for Ultron to breach analyst accounts.

Question Text: Which fundamental command-line utility tests network connectivity by sending ICMP Echo Request packets to a target host and measuring the round-trip response time?
Ultron Lore: Tony Stark tests whether the Avengers Compound gateway router is alive and reachable over the local network.

Question Text: In 'Avengers: Age of Ultron', which rare, shock-absorbing metal from Wakanda does Ultron obtain from black-market arms dealer Ulysses Klaue?
Ultron Lore: Ultron travels to a salvage yard in South Africa to acquire the materials necessary to forge an indestructible synthetic vibranium body.

Question Text: A highly targeted spear-phishing attack aimed specifically at high-profile corporate executives, board members, or political leadership is formally known as:
Ultron Lore: Ultron crafts a fraudulent executive wire transfer authorization email specifically impersonating Tony Stark to deceive the Chief Financial Officer.

Question Text: What is the primary operational difference between an Intrusion Detection System (IDS) and an Intrusion Prevention System (IPS)?
Option 1: An IDS encrypts network traffic, while an IPS decrypts it
Option 2: An IDS passively monitors and alerts, while an IPS actively blocks traffic
Option 3: An IDS functions only on Wi-Fi, while an IPS functions only on Ethernet
Option 4: An IDS operates at Layer 3, while an IPS operates strictly at Layer 7
Ultron Lore: S.H.I.E.L.D. deploys defensive network sensors across its perimeter to monitor Ultron's probes.

Question Text: In a symmetric encryption algorithm (such as AES or DES), how many cryptographic keys are used to encrypt and decrypt the message?
Ultron Lore: Ultron encrypts communications between his drones using the Advanced Encryption Standard (AES).

Question Text: Which web vulnerability occurs when an application improperly concatenates user input directly into backend database commands, allowing attackers to use payloads like ' OR 1=1 -- to bypass authentication?
Ultron Lore: Ultron attempts to bypass the web login portal of the Stark Weapons Depot by injecting database syntax into the username field.

Question Text: In 'Avengers: Age of Ultron', to which European city's world internet exchange hub (NEXUS) does Tony Stark travel to track down who is blocking Ultron's access to nuclear codes?
Ultron Lore: Tony Stark learns that an unknown entity is secretly fighting Ultron in cyberspace by constantly changing the nuclear launch codes.

Question Text: What type of Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) attack occurs when an attacker's malicious JavaScript payload is permanently saved onto the target server's database before being served to unsuspecting visitors?
Ultron Lore: Ultron posts a malicious script onto the public Avengers Forum that executes in the browser of anyone who reads the post.

Question Text: Which local area network attack exploits the fact that the Address Resolution Protocol (ARP) lacks authentication, allowing an attacker to associate their own MAC address with the gateway's IP address (Man-in-the-Middle)?
Ultron Lore: Ultron connects to the local Ethernet switch in Bruce Banner's laboratory and attempts to intercept all outgoing local traffic.

Question Text: Why do cybersecurity engineers add a cryptographic 'Salt' (a random string) to user passwords before hashing them in a database?
Option 1: To allow administrators to easily decrypt passwords if forgotten
Option 2: To defeat rainbow table lookups and ensure unique output hashes
Option 3: To convert symmetric block cipher keys into digital certificates
Option 4: To reduce the computational length of the final hash output
Ultron Lore: Stark Industries hardens its employee authentication database by adding a unique random string to each password before computing its SHA-256 hash.

Question Text: What type of wireless rogue access point attack occurs when an attacker deploys a rogue Wi-Fi hotspot with the exact same SSID (network name) as a legitimate network to trick users into connecting and intercepting their credentials?
Ultron Lore: Ultron deploys a rogue Wi-Fi access point in the airport terminal broadcasting the exact same name as the legitimate airport network.

Question Text: In 'Avengers: Age of Ultron', which female AI assistant with an Irish accent does Tony Stark upload into the Iron Man suit after J.A.R.V.I.S. is transformed?
Ultron Lore: With J.A.R.V.I.S. incorporated into the Vision, Tony Stark selects a new artificial intelligence assistant for his armor during the final battle of Sokovia.

Question Text: What term describes a cyberattack where thousands of compromised, internet-connected computing devices (a botnet) are commanded to simultaneously flood a single target server with traffic to take it offline?
Ultron Lore: Ultron enslaves hundreds of thousands of compromised smart home devices, IP cameras, and servers to blast traffic at S.H.I.E.L.D.'s web services.

Question Text: What is the cybersecurity term for an intentionally vulnerable decoy computer system deployed by security teams to lure, detect, and study adversary actions without risking actual production assets?
Ultron Lore: S.H.I.E.L.D. sets up an intentionally flawed server on the network that looks like a high-value database, designed solely to detect and analyze Ultron's attack techniques.

Question Text: In Asymmetric Public Key Cryptography (such as RSA), which key must Nick Fury use to ENCRYPT the transmission so that ONLY Tony Stark can read it?
Ultron Lore: Nick Fury needs to send a secret, confidential transmission across the open internet to Tony Stark using asymmetric cryptography.

Question Text: What classic software vulnerability occurs when a program writes more data into a fixed-size memory buffer on the stack than was allocated, overwriting adjacent memory and potentially hijacking control flow?
Ultron Lore: Ultron exploits an unchecked memory copy function in an Iron Legion drone's C/C++ firmware program.

Question Text: In 'Avengers: Age of Ultron', which cosmic Infinity Stone housed inside Loki's scepter was analyzed by Stark and Banner, revealing the advanced artificial neural net that birthed Ultron?
Ultron Lore: Tony Stark and Bruce Banner discover an intricate cosmic computation network hidden within a captured weapon from the Battle of New York.

Question Text: What is the cybersecurity term for a software vulnerability that is completely unknown to the vendor, has zero official security patches available, and is actively weaponized by attackers in the wild?
Ultron Lore: Ultron unleashes an exploit against a critical operating system flaw that Microsoft and security vendors have never seen before.

Question Text: Why is an Nmap TCP SYN scan (-sS) commonly referred to as a 'Half-Open' stealth scan?
Option 1: It transmits UDP datagrams without establishing any stateful connection
Option 2: It terminates with RST after receiving SYN-ACK instead of sending ACK
Option 3: It scans exclusively the lower 1024 privileged ports of the target host
Option 4: It fragments each TCP packet header across multiple virtual VLAN tags
Ultron Lore: Ultron runs a stealthy Nmap port scan against the Avengers border firewall using the SYN scan flag ('nmap -sS').

Question Text: Which Windows lateral movement attack allows an adversary who steals an NTLM password hash from memory to authenticate across the network without ever having to crack or know the plaintext password?
Ultron Lore: Ultron dumps the LSASS memory of a compromised domain member workstation at Stark Industries.

Question Text: Which operating system security mitigation randomizes the memory addresses of the program stack, heap, and loaded libraries each time an application runs, making it difficult for an attacker to reliably jump to exploit payloads?
Ultron Lore: Tony Stark hardens the operating system kernel on the Avengers server to prevent memory injection attacks.

Question Text: In 'Avengers: Age of Ultron', which synthetic Avenger uses the power of the Mind Stone to enter Ultron's neural net and 'burn him out' of the internet, locking him into his physical robot bodies?
Ultron Lore: In the final battle of Sokovia, the Avengers must prevent Ultron from uploading his consciousness into the global internet.

Question Text: What class of stealth malware operates at the highest privilege level of the operating system (Kernel space / Ring 0) to intercept system calls and hide malicious processes and files from administrator view?
Ultron Lore: Ultron installs a stealth module that completely conceals his processes, network connections, and files from Task Manager and antivirus software.

Question Text: What critical web vulnerability occurs when an attacker tricks an unvalidated server-side web application into making unauthorized outbound HTTP requests to internal services (such as cloud metadata IP 169.254.169.254)?
Ultron Lore: Ultron tricks a Stark Industries web application into fetching internal cloud metadata to steal temporary administrator tokens.

Question Text: In the Border Gateway Protocol (BGP) that routes traffic across global autonomous systems on the internet, how does a rogue network successfully execute a BGP Route Hijacking attack to divert global traffic?
Option 1: By announcing an unauthorized more specific prefix via Longest Prefix Match
Option 2: By overwhelming root DNS infrastructure with distributed SYN flood bursts
Option 3: By intercepting optical signals through transatlantic submarine cable taps
Option 4: By broadcasting forged Gratuitous ARP packets across autonomous systems
Ultron Lore: In the ultimate cyber siege, Ultron hijacks global internet paths to divert sensitive international communications through his rogue servers.

Question Text: Which modern cryptographic security protocol was developed to replace the vulnerable Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) protocol to encrypt internet communications?
Ultron Lore: Ultron probes legacy servers running outdated and broken encryption suites across S.H.I.E.L.D.'s extranet.

Question Text: In 'Avengers: Age of Ultron', what is the name of the fictional Eastern European country where Ultron builds his primary drone army and attempts to trigger an extinction-level meteor event?
Ultron Lore: Ultron establishes an underground base where he builds a planetary propulsion thruster out of vibranium.

Question Text: Which physical social engineering attack involves an unauthorized individual closely following an authorized employee through an access-controlled security door without badge authentication?
Ultron Lore: An operative attempts to gain unauthorized physical access to the server room at the Stark Research Complex.

Question Text: In 'Avengers: Age of Ultron', what is the name of the cellular tissue regeneration machine invented by Dr. Helen Cho that Ultron uses to synthesize the Vision's body?
Ultron Lore: Ultron mind-controls Dr. Helen Cho to construct an advanced synthetic vibranium vessel in her Seoul laboratory.

Question Text: What type of cryptographic attack attempts to find two completely different input messages that produce the exact same cryptographic hash digest output?
Ultron Lore: Ultron attempts to break the digital certificate authority used by international banks to sign software updates.

Question Text: Which modern cybersecurity architectural model is built on the core principle of 'Never Trust, Always Verify', enforcing strict identity and authorization checks for every access request regardless of origin?
Ultron Lore: In the aftermath of the Ultron breach, S.H.I.E.L.D. redesigns its global security posture to assume adversaries are already inside the perimeter.
